Folks — attaching a short risk blurb for the QBR one-pager and the slide callouts I think are appropriate. Feel free to pare down.

Risk blurb (<=200 words):
Dedicated deployment for Acme is on track but carries residual risk around peak KV-cache warm-up and replay behavior during the first 72 hours of sustained traffic. If warm-up lags expected hit-rates, we may see transient p95 regressions at peak concurrency; mitigation described: staged cutover with real-time metrics gating (traffic ramp + auto-fallback to hosted variant) and a 2-hour rollback window. Cost impact of fallback is limited to short burst capacity and will be captured in the post-cutover invoice.

Slide callouts:
- Slide 3: Migration timeline + gated milestones.
- Slide 6: Benchmarks summary (p50/p95 token latency, token/sec) with run-IDs in the footnote.
- Slide 8: Risk + rollback plan (use language above).

I'll drop the blurb into the deck and add the Slide 6 benchmark table when Marissa confirms the final run-IDs.

Vivek
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
